payout_quote: Basic: Free, 10 Bids per Month, One Bid per Quote, 9% Job Fee
steps: Create a free Guru account on the Basic plan and build a freelancer profile with skills and portfolio.
Browse publicly posted jobs and submit quotes (bids) — Basic includes 10 bids per month.
Get selected by the employer, agree terms, and complete the work through Guru's Work Room.
Get paid via Guru's SafePay; Guru deducts the 9% job fee from completed earnings.
catches: The free Basic plan allows only 10 bids per month — volume beyond that needs a paid plan (not required to start).
Quoting is competitive; most quotes lose and earn nothing.
Job budgets are set by employers; Guru publishes no fixed freelancer pay range.
A 9% job fee is deducted from every completed job.
Identity verification is required before withdrawing funds.
biggest_catch: You only get paid for jobs you win and complete — and the free plan caps you at 10 bids a month with a 9% fee on every win.
eligibility: Anyone who can create a free Guru account and legally freelance in their jurisdiction; skills must match posted jobs.
timing: Jobs post continuously; payouts on job completion via SafePay.
